_comment: User-provided valid default values for Dolibarr (PHP ERP, native HTML forms). Starter scaffold — extend after running extract on the pages you plan to test. Keys can be plain labels or section-qualified ('Section > Label'). Section-qualified wins when both are present. Many of these field names come from Dolibarr's standard third-party/company/contact/product forms; adjust to match your install's exact labels (localization may rename them).
_dependencies_comment: Wall 1.1 — fill when you detect cascaded dropdowns on Dolibarr (State depends on Country is the common one). Leave empty until observed.
